name: sympathy
quote: I hope your dog feels better.
description: Recognizing the suffering of a person or animal accompanied by a desire to see them better off.

commentaries.quote: With pity, there's a sense that the person sorta deserves the suffering. With sympathy, they're innocent victims but you can only help with moral support. With compassion, you're offering more tangible help.

conditions: You recognize undeserved suffering in another, but cannot or will not help.
